question_ko: 같은 모델과 총 예산을 쓸 때, AI 연구자가 작은 실행 환경에서 먼저 실험을 끝까지 연습하면 바로 시작하는 것보다 실제 과제의 최종 점수가 좋아지는가?

recommendation.reason: The paper validates large-scale SFT on reconstructed coding environments, not fixed-LLM inference-time rehearsal or a simulator of future ML performance. Public ML originals permit exact snapshots; a distinctive advantage over ordinary smoke and mini-fit checks is unspecified.

source.title: Terminal-Universe: Turning Agent Trajectories into Scalable Terminal Environments

evidence.claim: Replay is lossy, recovers earliest observed files, withholds created solution files; completion supplies latent context.
Sufficiency checks available project context rather than build success; unseen project-specific content cannot be recovered.
Manual review found 8 of 30 completions added substantial unnecessary material; no solutions found in those 30.
Synthesis covers recovered intent, single/cross-workspace tasks, and multi-round user follow-ups.
Single/Cross trajectories are pass-filtered; Multi-Round trims trailing failures; Intent Recovery is not verifier-filtered.
Main treatment is 27B SFT on 31,977 demonstrations, approximately 1.42B tokens, two epochs; generation uses Qwen3.7-Max xhigh.
Reported TB2.1 and EvoCode gains concern SFT coding-agent evaluation, not frozen-LLM ML experiment rehearsal.
Re-solving uses a stronger teacher and changes the demonstration policy relative to raw source SFT.
Generic container, source coverage, and correlated task/solution/verifier teacher errors limit conclusions.
The text supplies no calibrated simulator fidelity or counterfactual future ML score result.
Fixed-LLM rehearsal is a possible transfer hypothesis, not an evaluated mechanism in this paper.

mechanism: Actual small-data end-to-end execution, observations, revision, and transfer into a real target experiment with no LLM weight update.

matched_comparison.private_evaluation: Only final scoring uses hidden evaluation; agent chooses experiments on development split.

single_primary_endpoint: Final private-evaluation score under identical total resource budgets, compared in matched task/seed pairs.
demonstration: Two exact copies of one public ML task compare standard mini-fit with targeted rehearsal, displaying actual budget spent, observed failure, applied revision, and final hidden score. No predicted score is represented as a real run.

cheap_falsifier.execution_plan_first: Reject if the proposed rehearsal reduces to the same standard smoke/mini-fit calls.
cheap_falsifier.development_probe: Three distinct public ML tasks, all costs charged, matched frozen model and budgets, real target fits after rehearsal.
cheap_falsifier.stop_signal: No promising final-score improvement over the strong comparator, or gains limited to ordinary environment/input-output checks.

novelty_gap.relative_to_read_paper: Inference-time rehearsal transfer without SFT is not tested.
